assignments.onlyFuture: Applies to new payment sessions. Clear the selection to disable new bank-transfer sessions for this branch.

title: Payments
intro: Track incoming payments and manage receiving accounts.
limitsHelp: Record counter collections and allocate receipts with a reason. Closed/expired orders never reopen. Refund execution remains a separate, unavailable flow.
allocationHint: Allocated funds do not necessarily mean a confirmed order.
stage: Available now: Customer QR, SePay and automatic reconciliation
stageDetail: QR and webhooks use the account snapshot. Counter collections wait for Order acceptance. Declarations and bank evidence stay separate without double-counting. Refund execution is unavailable.
reloadHelp: If another session changed this record, close the form, reload and open the latest version. After a network error, retry the same details to safely retrieve the original result.
keyPresent: SePay API key configured — webhook intake available
feedHelp: Only SEPAY_API_KEY in .env.docker is needed for SePay configuration. Bank connections and webhooks must still be set up in SePay; adding an account here does not connect its transaction feed.
bankCodeHelp: Public bank directory from SePay. Search by name, code or BIN; selecting either field updates both and saves the bank code. This does not connect your account to SePay.
bankListUnavailable: The bank directory could not be loaded. Existing bank details are preserved.
inactiveHelp: Deactivation preserves history and existing branch assignments; select another account for new collections.
assignmentHelp: Each branch has one current receiving account. An account can serve multiple branches. New assignments do not modify historical transactions.
clearAssignment: Clear the selection to unassign this branch's account.
required: Enter valid details within the allowed length.
invalidCode: Use 2–20 letters or digits with no spaces.
invalidAccount: Use up to 80 digits and preserve leading zeros.
intakeOnly: A received transaction is not a paid order
intakeOnlyDetail: Allocated does not necessarily mean fully paid or confirmed. Partial payments wait; overpayments and late money remain for review. Legacy payments are not automatically upgraded. Date filters use server receipt time in Vietnam time.
invalidDateRange: Choose valid dates with the start no later than the end.
conflictHelp: The same SePay ID arrived with different financial data. The original receipt is retained; funds are not overwritten or counted twice.
storeScopeHelp: View funds, record collections and reconcile within store #{{storeId}}. Unclassified or conflicting receipts are Admin-only. No refund action is available here.
operationsHelp: Record actual cash and declared transfers. Explain shortages/excess. Accepted collection does not mean bank verification or order completion.

collectionStates.PENDING: Waiting for Order acceptance — not yet successful

operationStored: Operation stored. Check the collection status below: PENDING is not acceptance. Reload to retrieve the Order decision.
operationRetryHelp: After a timeout/network error, retry the same operation below using its original idempotency key. For stale/rejected data, reload the order and receipt.
linkCollection: Link to accepted collection (do not add the declaration twice)
acceptOriginalConflict: Admin: after reviewing the conflict, I approve using the immutable original receipt; conflict history is retained
conflictHistory: Conflicting variants (latest 20); these do not replace the original above
conflictFlags: Same receiving account as original: {{account}} · Sub-account/VA present: {{sub}}
legacyHelp: Activate only a unique, complete original snapshot whose deadline still matches Order and has not expired. Never replace its bank account or extend its deadline. Incomplete evidence stays review-only without a QR.

receiptReasons.MANUAL_ALLOCATION: Manually allocated with a reason; Order decides the final state
receiptReasons.COLLECTION_EVIDENCE: Evidence for a declared transfer; collection total is not increased again
receiptReasons.LEGACY_REVIEW: Historical payment reconciliation only; no order reopening
receiptReasons.ALLOCATED: Added to the order balance; check the order status for confirmation
receiptReasons.ORDER_CLOSED: Order closed or expired; funds retained without reopening the order
receiptReasons.ORDER_REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND: No matching payment reference yet; a store is shown only with receiving-account evidence
receiptReasons.STORE_REFERENCE_CONFLICT: Inconsistent store references — Admin review required
receiptReasons.STORE_ORDER_CONFLICT: The payment token belongs to another store — Admin review required
receiptReasons.INCOMPLETE_SNAPSHOT: Legacy payment lacks a trustworthy snapshot
receiptReasons.BANK_ACCOUNT_MISMATCH: Receiving bank or account does not match the snapshot
receiptReasons.SUB_ACCOUNT_REVIEW: Sub-account / virtual account needs separate review
receiptReasons.AWAITING_RECONCILIATION: Reference and receiving account fit; business reconciliation is pending
receiptReasons.OUTGOING: Outgoing transfers do not count as payment or automatic refunds
